predictions.articleTitle: Italy U17 vs Armenia U17 Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Azzurrini Break Armenia's Low Block?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Italy U17 to secure a comfortable Matchday 2 victory built on superior Serie A academy depth and second-half scoring acceleration.
possibilityAssessment: Italy U17 win by multiple goals through sustained territorial control and bench quality (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 total goals driven by high attacking expectancy against an exposed Armenian backline (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Draw-Win half-time/full-time script if early rotation and host compactness delay Italy's breakthrough until the second half (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Italy U17's multi-scorer attack targets Armenia's leaky Yerevan defense.

spf.comment: Italy U17's 6-0 opener and deeper academy roster cleanly outmatch an Armenia U17 side that allowed 26 shots against France.

over_under.comment: A 5.00 combined goal-expectancy lambda and lopsided Matchday 1 results point firmly toward at least three goals.

score.comment: 4:0 mirrors Armenia's Matchday 1 defeat to France, while 3:0 covers early Italian game management ahead of France.

goals.comment: Four and three total goals balance Italy's high scoring ceiling against potential second-half substitution pacing.

bqc.comment: Italy can either strike early like France did in Yerevan or break down Armenia's low block after half-time.
